data_description.api_region: Use EU for accounts handled by the European VeSync service. Use GLOBAL for the US and other non-EU regions.
data_description.country_code: Two-letter ISO country code for the VeSync account, for example HU, DE, GB or US.
data_description.password: Used only for this one first-stage VeSync sign-in request. It is not stored by the probe.
data_description.username: Email address used by the VeSync account. It is not stored by the probe.

user.description: This diagnostic tool runs beside Home Assistant's built-in VeSync integration. It sends one first-stage VeSync sign-in request, records only sanitized MFA metadata, and stops. It does not create entities, replace the built-in VeSync integration, exchange an authorization code for a session, or submit a one-time code.
user.title: Probe VeSync 2FA authentication
